title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: At the moment Su Qingyao made her choice, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly glowed with an eerie light, a reaction never seen before, foretelling that deeper secrets were about to be unveiled.

text.content:
The night wind was like a blade, cutting across Chen Ji's face. He gazed at where Chen Ling had vanished, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm burning faintly hot, as if responding to the unspeakable grief in his heart. Moonlight fell upon the empty cliff, stretching his solitary silhouette into a thin, elongated line.

He had been standing alone for so long, long enough for his garments to be soaked by the night dew, long enough for his fingertips to turn pale white from clenching. That girl who had always followed behind him, calling him brother, had simply turned into scattered Spiritual Light, dissipating into this endless night.

dialogue.content: (He murmured softly, his voice hoarse and barely audible) Chen Ling... Brother promises you, I will definitely find a way.

text.content:
Just then, hurried footsteps came from behind. Chen Ji didn't turn around—he had already recognized the walker from their gait—the woman who was always coldly aloof yet persistently pursued the truth.

Su Qingyao's figure appeared at the cliff's edge, moonlight illuminating her coldly beautiful face. Her brow was tightly furrowed, clearly having urgent matters to share. However, when she saw the faintly glowing Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hand, her body stiffened abruptly.

dialogue.content: (She hurried forward, her voice carrying an irrepressible urgency) Chen Ji, the thing in your hand... I can feel it calling to me.

text.content:
Chen Ji finally turned around, his gaze deep and complex under the moonlight. He looked at Su Qingyao, at that face as coldly beautiful as frost even in the deep night, and suddenly noticed a faint light flickering at her Brow Center.

That light... was identical to the glow of the Tianji Record Fragment.

His pupils constricted sharply, and a guess that even shocked himself surged in his heart.

dialogue.content: (He lowered his voice, his gaze tightly fixed on the faint light at Su Qingyao's Brow Center) Su Senior Sister, when did the light at your Brow Center start?

(She unconsciously touched her Brow Center, her fingertips burning with heat) It was just now... when the Fragment in your hand glowed. I suddenly felt a sharp pain in my chest, and then I sensed some kind of... summoning.

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't speak. Instead, he slowly raised the Tianji Record Fragment. The runes on the Fragment flowed under the moonlight, emitting a faint golden glow. As he moved, the light at Su Qingyao's Brow Center suddenly intensified, resonating with the Fragment's glow.

The two lights intertwined, sketching a vague pattern in the air—a spread book scroll, somewhat similar in form to the Tianji Record.

choice.prompt: Faced with this sudden phenomenon, Chen Ji had to make a decision—

choices.text: Attempt to use the Tianji Record to peer into Su Qingyao's fate
choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value, use the Tianji Record to see what secret Su Qingyao is hiding. This might be the key to unraveling the mystery.
choices.visible_reward: Uncover a corner of the bloodline truth
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value is already scarce, this action may bring unknown risks

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and injected a wisp of divine consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment. In an instant, golden light engulfed Su Qingyao. Her eyes flew open, her pupils reflecting countless flowing runes.

dialogue.content: (Her voice trembled, as if experiencing some shocking scene) I saw... a name... written on a long list... it was handwriting from ten thousand years ago...

choices.text: Let Su Qingyao actively approach the Fragment
choices.description: Don't actively peer; instead, let Su Qingyao resonate with the Fragment herself. Perhaps something within her will awaken on its own.
choices.visible_reward: Let Su Qingyao reveal the truth herself

text.content:
Chen Ji placed the Fragment flat in his palm and extended it toward Su Qingyao.

Su Qingyao hesitated for a moment, but finally reached out her hand. The moment her fingertips touched the Fragment, a powerful force suddenly surged from within it, rushing straight toward her Brow Center!

dialogue.content: (She clutched her Brow Center in pain, her body trembling violently) Ah... it hurts... something... is awakening within me...

choices.text: First ask for Mo Xiansheng's opinion
choices.description: Before taking action, contact Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the Tianji Record. Perhaps he can provide some key information.

text.content: Chen Ji silently called Mo Xiansheng's name in his heart. After a moment, an elderly voice echoed in his mind, carrying a hint of astonishment and solemnity.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice resounded in his mind) The bloodline of a Fate Scribe... after ten thousand years, has it finally appeared again? Chen Ji, this woman carries blood from the same source as the Tianji Record in your hand. Her ancestor was one of the Eight Scribes who assisted the first Tianji Record master in writing the Fates Scroll!

text.content:
Su Qingyao's body floated into the air, enveloped in a faint golden halo. At her Brow Center, the mark hidden for twenty years was finally revealed—a delicate rune, identical to certain runes on the Tianji Record.

Chen Ji seeing this, his heart was rocked by immense waves. He finally understood why Su Qingyao could always detect his anomalies—it wasn't keen perception, but an instinct flowing within her bloodline.

dialogue.content: (Her voice ethereal and distant, as if recounting some ancient memory) I saw... the scene from ten thousand years ago... a massive altar... eight people seated around a golden book scroll... I was one of them... no, it was my ancestor...

text.content:
Light and shadow shifted, Su Qingyao's consciousness pulled into that ancient era. She saw the golden book scroll—the true Tianji Record, far more complete than the Fragment in Chen Ji's hand by a hundredfold. She saw eight figures bending over writing quickly, weaving countless people's fates into that scroll of names.

And on the final page of that scroll, she saw a familiar name.

It was her own name.

Not Su Qingyao, but a more ancient surname, yet the brand deep in her soul told her—that was her. Ten thousand years ago, it was already destined that she would appear here, by Chen Ji's side.

dialogue.content: (Her voice filled with disbelief) Impossible... this is impossible... how could I be a person from ten thousand years ago... the name written by that remnant soul on the scroll... is me...

choice.prompt: Faced with this shocking truth, Su Qingyao had to make a choice—

choices.description: Completely accept the power and memories brought by bloodline awakening, becoming a true inheritor of the Fate Scribe bloodline. This will fundamentally change her identity.
choices.visible_reward: Gain partial abilities of a Fate Scribe
choices.risk_hint: May lose the self, develop deeper bonds but also deeper entanglements with Chen Ji

text.content:
Su Qingyao closed her eyes, letting that force surge within her. Her Brow Center rune grew brighter and brighter, finally transforming into a brilliant light that shot straight into the sky.

When the light faded, her temperament had already changed. That cold aloofness now carried a bit more world-weary detachment, as if she was no longer simply a Tianqing Sect disciple, but some existence that transcended worldly affairs.

dialogue.content: (She opened her eyes, galaxies seeming to flow within her gaze) I understand now... I am not a reincarnation from ten thousand years ago, but her bloodline heir... the blood of a Fate Scribe flows within me... Chen Ji, perhaps I am indeed the key to your fourth possibility.

choices.text: Suppress the power, maintain the self
choices.description: Forcefully suppress the awakening power within, maintaining current identity and relationships. This is a conservative yet steady choice.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain current identity and interpersonal relationships
choices.risk_hint: Power may be accidentally triggered, bringing greater trouble

text.content:
Su Qingyao gritted her teeth, mobilizing all her willpower to suppress the surging force within her. The veins on her forehead bulged, blood dripping from her nostrils, but she resolutely sealed that power back into the depths of her Brow Center with astonishing willpower.

The light gradually dimmed, and her Brow Center rune also retreated beneath her skin once more.

dialogue.content: (She breathed weakly, but her gaze remained firm) I... cannot fully accept this power yet... but I can sense its existence... Chen Ji, I don't know if I am the key to the fourth possibility, but I know... I want to help you.

choices.text: Share the power with Chen Ji
choices.description: Attempt to fuse her bloodline power with the Tianji Record Fragment, establishing a connection with Chen Ji in another way. This is a brand-new possibility.
choices.visible_reward: Form blood resonance with Chen Ji, creating a deeper bond
choices.risk_hint: An unprecedented attempt, results hard to predict

text.content:
Su Qingyao reached out, pressing her palm against the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hand. Her bloodline power merged with the power within the Fragment, forming some kind of strange resonance.

Chen Ji felt a warm force flow in from his palm, intertwining with the power within him. At this moment, he clearly sensed Su Qingyao's emotions—determination, gentleness, and that thread of deep affection she was unwilling to speak.

dialogue.content: (Her voice gentle yet firm) Since my bloodline shares the same source as the Tianji Record... then my power should be at your service... from now on, our bloodlines are connected, life and death intertwined.

text.content:
Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently. The originally dim runes now burst forth with dazzling light, as if responding to Su Qingyao's bloodline's call.

Chen Ji and Su Qingyao both looked at the Fragment, only to see ancient text slowly emerge within the golden light—content that had never appeared on the Tianji Record Fragment before.

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from the Fragment, carrying irrepressible excitement) The fourth possibility... blood resonance... so that's how it is... Chen Ji, this woman is not merely a witness to fate, she is the key to your breakthrough!

The Tianji Record chose you because it sensed her existence... no, perhaps it should be said... her existence guided the Tianji Record to find you!

text.content:
Chen Ji hearing this, immense waves surged in his heart. He had always believed obtaining the Tianji Record was fate's arrangement, a chance encounter. Yet he never expected, everything was actually related to Su Qingyao?

He turned to look at Su Qingyao. Under the moonlight, her face remained coldly beautiful, but those eyes now held a softness never seen before. She had just made such a choice—sharing her bloodline power with him, regardless of cost.

This affection, heavier than Mount Tai.

choice.prompt: Faced with Su Qingyao's deep affection and Mo Xiansheng's revelation, Chen Ji had to respond—

choices.description: Lay out all his plans, including the true purpose of the Tianji Record and the meaning of the fourth possibility. He decided to trust her.
choices.visible_reward: Establish true trust with Su Qingyao
choices.risk_hint: Lose information advantage, but if she betrays, the loss would be enormous

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and made the most risky decision since his transmigration—revealing his deepest secrets to an outsider.

He tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his chest, then looked directly into Su Qingyao's eyes and spoke the plan buried deepest in his heart, word by word.

dialogue.content:
(His voice calm, but his gaze unprecedentedly serious) Su Qingyao, since you chose to be bloodline-bound with me... there are some things you truly should know.

The complete version of the Tianji Record... it can rewrite fate. And what I intend to do is use its power to break the chess game of the Heavenly Eye.

choices.description: Thank her for her sacrifice, but temporarily withhold more information. He was accustomed to bearing burdens alone and didn't want to involve her too deeply.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage, protect her safety
choices.risk_hint: May make Su Qingyao feel alienated

text.content:
Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then gently shook his head. He reached out and gently grasped Su Qingyao's wrist, feeling the bloodline power still faintly pulsing beneath her skin.

Her sacrifice was so great, how could he not be moved? But precisely because of this, he could not let her risk danger too deeply.

dialogue.content:
(He said softly, his tone carrying a hint of apology) Su Senior Sister... I received your kind intentions. But my path is too dangerous, I don't want to implicate you.

You've already helped me a lot... let the rest be mine to handle alone.

choices.description: Since she is already in a state of blood resonance, formally include her in his chess game and make her a true ally.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful blood resonance partner
choices.risk_hint: Need to readjust plans to accommodate her existence

text.content:
A meaningful smile slightly lifted the corners of Chen Ji's mouth. He didn't refuse Su Qingyao's kindness, but neither did he reveal everything—this was his consistent style.

What he had always wanted was never one-sided giving, but true partners in cooperation.

dialogue.content:
(His tone carried more recognition) Su Senior Sister, since you insist on helping me... then let me suggest a different approach.

From now on, you are no longer the one investigating me, but an ally fighting shoulder to shoulder with me. Any discoveries, we can share; any plans, we can discuss together.

How does such cooperation sound to you?

text.content:
Su Qingyao looked at Chen Ji, at this man she had investigated for so long yet could never see through. Under the moonlight, his face was calm as water, but those eyes hid stormy seas.

She finally understood, why this man could survive the struggles among the three major sects, why he could emerge unscathed when the Demonic Path invaded, why he was called trash yet always turned the tide at critical moments.

Because he never walked the conventional path, because he was always calculating.

And now, he extended his hand to her, inviting her into that chess game only he alone knew.

dialogue.content: (She grasped his hand without hesitation) Happy cooperation, Chen Ji. From now on, my sword is your sword.

text.content:
The night wind remained cold, but Chen Ji at this moment felt a long-lost warmth. He had lost Chen Ling, but gained a true ally in Su Qingyao.

The runes on the Tianji Record Fragment gradually dimmed, but Chen Ji knew, everything that happened tonight would thoroughly change the direction of this chess game.

Su Qingyao was not only an heir of the Fate Scribe bloodline, she was also the key to the fourth possibility—a existence capable of resonating with the Tianji Record yet not bound by it.

This meant, he no longer had to face the Heavenly Eye's chess game alone.

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of relief) Excellent... blood resonance has formed, the雏形 of the fourth possibility has appeared.

Chen Ji, remember this—the fourth possibility is not merely a method to break fate, but the key to transcending the Tianji Record itself.

But be careful... the Heavenly Eye has already sensed the changes here. Your awakening has alarmed it.

text.content:
The words had barely fallen when the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently. A nameless oppression descended from the Void, as if some invisible existence was watching this place.

Chen Ji and Su Qingyao simultaneously looked up, only to see the starry sky above seemed to distort for an instant, a faint gaze descending from the Nine Heavens, cold and merciless.

That was the Heavenly Eye's gaze.

It, had finally noticed everything happening here.

And this, was merely the prelude to the storm...
